author: Josué de la Place (Placeus)
work: De imputatione primi peccati Adami (Caput Primum tip)
edition: De imputatione primi peccati Adami (Salmurii: Apud Ioannem Lesnerium, 1661). IA deimputationepri00lapl. Tip: Caput Primum (Decretum Synodi Charentonii 1644/45 + Placeus framing). Earlier 1655 Saumur print exists; tip copy-text is the 1661 Lesnerius.
